class_semantics: Author-selected interesting/mountable protein crystals and drops. Other unannotated crystals are not exhaustive generic negatives. No seed/secondary/inclusion mapping.

selection.rule: Ascending SHA256(prefix + sample_id), separately within original author split and source dataset; select before conversion checks. Do not replace rejected images.

polygon_export.policy: One nondegenerate external contour per source instance, small holes filled with measured loss. Reject the complete image if any object cannot be represented; retain original masks and rejection details, never convert unsupported objects into negatives.

evaluation.matching: Class-wise maximum total native-mask IoU assignment; retain matches above fixed threshold. Report source-selected targets, unmatched predictions and misses separately.
evaluation.selection_scope: Author-validation image pilot only; physical run/plate grouping unknown, not an independent KDP evaluation.
evaluation.baseline: No comparative improvement claim in this first real-pixel-label fit. Training/validation scores describe only the declared source-selected task.
